extra: Held-out test set: n = 1,040 images, split by lesion so the same lesion never appears in both training and test. Melanoma AUC 0.86; malignant-vs-benign AUC 0.89. Melanoma alert operating point chosen on the validation set: threshold 0.10 → validation sensitivity 86% / specificity 80%; test sensitivity 77% / specificity 82%. At 0.20: test sensitivity 55% / specificity 91%; at 0.50: 24% / 99%. Dermatologist-level systems reach melanoma AUC ≈ 0.90–0.94.
